subject: Lockdown: coverage inventory + finance nudge for Q3 commit
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Lockdown: coverage inventory + finance nudge for Q3 commit

Team / Samantha —

We need to lock coverage for Q3 this week. Finance has asked for a cleaned pipe and commit tags by EOD Wednesday (23 Jun). Quick asks: 

- Marcus / sales owners: flag any deals that you expect to close in Q3 with >80% confidence and update their stage to "Commit" or "Commit - Contingent". Remove or archive stale opportunities (no activity in 90+ days).
- Neha / Lauren: once the stage updates land, can finance pull an updated run-rate and provide the run-rate adjustment (delta vs FY target) by Thursday morning?
- Samantha / Acme procurement: we appreciate your patience — if there are any procurement milestones tied to the mutual action plan, please call out timing in reply so we can map to our commit.

I've attached a quick export of the Q2 pipeline and our working mutual action plan stub. Marcus, please add estimated close dates and a short confidence note per opp.

Thanks — short, sharp updates only please.

Logan
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q2-pipeline-export.csv (CSV export, 48KB); mutual-action-plan-ACME.pdf (MVP MOP)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lockdown: coverage inventory + finance nudge for Q3 commit

Thanks Logan — quick update from my side:

- Marked 6 opportunities as Commit (ACME-2026-07 included) with expected close window 7/15–7/31 and confidence notes in the CRM.
- Cleaned 12 stale opps (moved to "Archive - stale") where no activity since Jan. Saved comments on why (budget, product fit, lost to competitor).
- Left 4 large deals in "Commit - Contingent" pending procurement signoff (I've added short notes and linked the MAP for each).

Samantha — flagged ACME-2026-07 as Commit because procurement expects to finalize terms in the next 2–3 weeks; I set close date 2026-07-22. If procurement timing slips, we'll move to Contingent.

Logan / Neha: CSV updated row for ACME-2026-07 with estimated ARR and expected start date.

- Marcus
Senior Account Executive

On attaching: Q2 export updated in thread.

From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Analytics Procurement <procurement@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lockdown: coverage inventory + finance nudge for Q3 commit

Thanks Marcus / Logan — appreciate the clarity. A couple notes from procurement: 

- We are on track to present redlines to legal by 7/2. Full signature is dependent on 2 vendor approvals (security questionnaire turnaround and internal budget cadence). Expect final signature by 7/20–7/28 if no surprises.
- For forecasting: we can tentatively commit to a Q3 start (billing) target of 2026-07-25, but will confirm once legal returns redlines. Please treat as "Commit - Contingent" until signatures complete.

If it helps, I can share the procurement milestone tracker (PDF) — would you like that attached?

Best,
Samantha
Head of Procurement, Acme Analytics

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lockdown: coverage inventory + finance nudge for Q3 commit

Great — thanks everyone for quick moves. Final checklist / next steps so Finance can close the book for the week: 

1) Sales owners: by EOD Wednesday confirm final tag for each opp (Commit / Commit - Contingent / Archive). I expect only the 4 deals Marcus mentioned to remain Contingent.
2) Marcus: add brief one-line rationale for each Contingent opp (procurement blocker / PO timing / SOC2 evidence delay).
3) Neha / Lauren: once tags are in, run the adjusted run-rate and send a short summary (delta vs target) + a single-sheet with upside/downside scenarios.
4) Samantha: when you share procurement tracker that will be super helpful — please cc procurement@redwood.com so we can mirror milestones.

I'll lock the CRM view at 17:30 PT and take a snapshot for finance. If anything material changes after snapshot, we'll treat as post-close adjustments.

If no objections, I'll archive the stale list Marcus flagged and circulate the final run-rate to execs on Thursday.

Thanks — Logan
